purpose: Ensure research performed in MAGI Bridge is not lost and is carried into the appropriate MAGI research lineage.
authoritative_rules: Every completed MAGI Bridge council is a research artifact, not disposable chat.
Bridge PASS means the submitted report is acceptable at the stated evidence strength; it never grants Gate promotion by itself.
AI/Claude cannot promote a Gate. Gate promotion requires the existing deterministic MAGI governance transition and persisted evidence.
A Bridge result must be routed into the correct research lineage and retained even when the verdict is REVISE, REJECT, STOPPED, or structured output fails.
Corrections do not erase prior records. A corrected record must identify what it supersedes and why.
required_ingest_fields: GPT/Claude transcript or a lossless reference to it

ingest_behavior.assistant_or_automation_initiated_bridge: Persist the resulting research handoff into .magi and update the relevant research record before declaring the task complete.
ingest_behavior.manual_browser_bridge_run: The browser currently retains the full run locally. The run becomes part of the central MAGI research record when its HANDOFF/result is shared into ChatGPT; on receipt it must be ingested without asking the user to reformat it.
ingest_behavior.invalid_or_truncated_output: Retain the research submission and failure evidence; do not silently discard the run.
ingest_behavior.gate_effect: NONE unless a separate deterministic Gate transition is executed under the frozen policy.
